$comment: Release self-declaration consumed by the unified registry's auto-core-release resolver (sh2-plugin-registry/scripts/resolve-core-candidate.mjs) at the git tag being released, and by this repo's release-descriptor step. supports.core is the semver range of core (backend) versions this frontend works with; while the platform is pre-1.0, every 0.x minor is breaking, so widen/bump it deliberately. Raise the lower bound whenever a frontend feature starts depending on a newer backend feature (e.g. a new/changed /cms-api endpoint or field-naming contract): the floor 0.1.17 is the first core release that emits the UNPREFIXED style field names this frontend reads after the field-naming unification (backend migration Version20260622165615 drops the `shared_` prefix from 47 style props - `shared_color`->`color`, `shared_variant`->`variant`, `shared_radius`->`radius`, ...; reserved `shared_height`/`shared_width`/`shared_icon` keep their prefix). That 0.1.17 floor also carries everything the previous 0.1.15 floor required - the mobile-rendering taxonomy (style `renderTarget`, required field `scope` driving inspector grouping, the unprefixed-common/web_/mobile_ field split with `pages.id_platform` removed in favour of the page access type) PLUS the alert/badge/avatar/button/login authoring-polish field set (alert `closable`; button/badge `variant`; badge `circle`; avatar `name`; login `subtitle`). This frontend (0.1.30) reads the unprefixed names via @selfhelp/shared >=1.14.22 (the prefix drop), so it MUST NOT be paired with a pre-0.1.17 core that still emits `shared_*`; the resolver refuses any incompatible frontend+backend pair in either direction. v0.1.30 also adds the anonymous-preview guard for the core >=0.1.18 behavior (an anonymous `preview=true` is now rejected with 401): preview is gated on a live session cookie and `sh_preview` is cleared on logout/expiry. That guard is backward-safe on older cores, so the `supports.core` floor previously stayed at 0.1.17. v0.1.31 adds the page-editor Mobile Preview panel, which mints a one-time preview code through the protected BFF route `POST /api/mobile-preview/session` -> core `POST /cms-api/v1/admin/mobile-preview/session`. That admin mint endpoint (plus the public `POST /mobile-preview/session/exchange` and the `MobilePreviewAccessGuard` read allowlist) first ships in core 0.1.19, so this floor is raised 0.1.17 -> 0.1.19 (the panel degrades to a graceful 'unavailable' state on older cores, but the version contract tracks the dependency). v0.1.32 adds the System Maintenance 'Update / enable mobile preview' lane (GET/POST /cms-api/v1/admin/system/update/mobile-preview/{releases,preflight,request}) and reads the new `mobile_preview_version` field from /admin/system/version; those endpoints + field first ship in core 0.1.20, so this floor is raised 0.1.19 -> 0.1.20 (the UI degrades gracefully on an older core, but the version contract tracks the dependency). v0.1.33 adds the full-screen CMS Live Preview surface (route `/admin/preview/[[...slug]]` + the editor 'Live preview' entry), gated on the new `admin.mobile_preview.view` permission; that permission is seeded (and granted to the admin role) by core migration Version20260623193630, first shipping in core 0.1.21, so this floor is raised 0.1.20 -> 0.1.21 (without it the route/entry degrade to no-access, but the version contract tracks the dependency). v0.1.34 reworks the Live Preview surface (one shared top-bar control set with Show Web/Show Mobile + a cookie-driven Draft toggle that also drives the same-origin web pane, plus an iframe lifecycle that unloads the frames when the tab is hidden or Stopped to free the dev server) and makes the login `dark`/`black` accent render adaptively so it stays readable in dark mode; both are floor-neutral (they reuse existing core endpoints/fields/permissions and add no new core dependency), so supports.core stays >=0.1.21. v0.1.35 redesigns the Live Preview into a single top control bar (frames-only canvas) and adds synchronized web<->mobile navigation via a postMessage preview bridge (the new @selfhelp/shared 1.15.2 contract; PreviewShellBridge mounted in the public website shell reports navigations + accepts soft navigate-to-keyword commands, loop-guarded), split web/mobile refresh keys, per-frame language handling, and hardened iframe sandboxing; it depends only on @selfhelp/shared >=1.15.2 and the selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.14 (which renders the matching mobile bridge + draft banner) and adds no new core dependency, so supports.core stays >=0.1.21. v0.1.36 fixes the Live Preview lifecycle (frames now unload only when the tab is hidden or Stopped, not on window blur / DevTools open), makes 'refresh mobile' a clean unmount->remount with a fresh session, mirrors the synced page into the master /admin/preview/<keyword> URL, and shows the in-frame mobile debug FAB; all floor-neutral (reuses existing core endpoints/fields/permissions), so supports.core stays >=0.1.21 (pairs with selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.15). v0.1.37 rebuilds the Live Preview web pane as an INLINE render (no iframe) reusing the real public renderer (DynamicPageClient) + client-composed website chrome, with in-process navigation interception (PreviewNavigationContext makes InternalLink/ButtonStyle/LinkStyle drive the preview) replacing the web postMessage bridge, bidirectional /admin/preview/<keyword> URL mirroring, and in-app draft/language controls (web size selector + toolbar language picker removed); the mobile pane stays an iframe on the existing mint + preview bridge, so it adds no new core dependency and supports.core stays >=0.1.21 (pairs with selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.15). v0.1.38 polishes that inline Live Preview: the mobile device controls (phone/tablet, portrait/landscape, mobile-only reload) move onto a floating pill over the mobile pane, the header avatar/profile menu navigation is routed through the same in-process preview interception (profile shows in both panes instead of unmounting the preview), and the mobile-only reload remounts the frame only once a fresh mint code is ready (fixing the perpetual-spinner wedge on the cross-origin Expo dev frame); all floor-neutral (reuses existing core endpoints/fields/permissions + the existing mint/preview-bridge contract), so supports.core stays >=0.1.21 (pairs with selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.15). v0.1.39 shares theme + language across the two Live Preview panes over the @selfhelp/shared 1.15.3 preview bridge (pairs with selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.17). v0.1.40 makes language web-driven and URL-bound (the mobile frame remounts at the chosen locale) while theme keeps syncing live, fixing the language-change request storm that emptied the mobile menu. v0.1.41 persists the device-frame controls across a preview reload and makes 'Refresh both' invalidate the web page-content cache. v0.1.42 reorganises the controls into the top header (device/orientation/mobile-reload on the right; Mobile/Draft/Refresh/open-in-new-tab on the left). v0.1.43 restores the mobile device bezel and sizes the frame to the body minus its own chrome so the bottom tab bar is no longer clipped, and removes the now-stranded legacy web postMessage bridge (buildWebPreviewUrl + PreviewShellBridge) since the web pane renders inline. v0.1.44 adds the server-side same-origin `/mobile-preview/*` rewrite used by manager local mode; production Traefik still routes that path directly, so this is floor-neutral and supports.core stays >=0.1.21. The resolver refuses any incompatible frontend+backend pair in either direction.
